description: Search Graunt's catalog of evaluated data from many sellers. Returns matching packets with their id, title, and public URL. Start here to find data, then read one with fetch. search_match.words says how the listings matched the query: ALL (every word, or a synonym of it), SOME (some of the words), WORD_START (words that start with the query's words), SIMILAR_TITLE (titles spelled like the query) or NONE (no listing). On SOME and WORD_START each listing names its matched_words. Each result's type is listing or pool, and search_match describes only listings. Pools use a separate keyword matcher over their public descriptions and data types. When no listing matches, next_steps.post_request_url opens a buyer request with the query filled in.

ai_generation.description: Keep only packets whose seller declares this AI-generation extent: NONE (not AI-generated), PARTIAL or FULL. A seller declaration, not a Graunt finding. AI processing of real material (cleaning, labeling, transcribing, captioning, structuring) is not AI generation, and a packet that contains video declares NONE.

camera_view.description: Only video listings shot from this camera view.

kind.description: Only listings of this kind of data, read from their media kind or their files.

rights_license_family.description: Keep only packets whose seller names this license family. In order, the values stand for: Proprietary, CC0 (public domain), CC BY, CC BY-SA, CC BY-NC, CC BY-ND, CC BY-NC-SA, CC BY-NC-ND, MIT, Apache 2.0, BSD 2-clause, BSD 3-clause, GPL 3.0, LGPL 3.0, MPL 2.0, ODC-BY, ODbL, Public domain, U.S. Government work. The rights the seller declared on the listing, which Graunt records: a seller declaration, not a Graunt finding.

rights_public_use.description: The "Show it publicly" permission: NONE keeps only packets that grant no public use, including those that record no answer; EDITORIAL, PROMOTIONAL and COMMERCIAL keep only packets that grant exactly that use. The rights the seller declared on the listing, which Graunt records: a seller declaration, not a Graunt finding.

rights_sublicense_one_client.description: The "Sublicensing to one client" permission: true keeps only packets a buyer may license for one client and pass the license through to that client; false keeps only those a buyer may not, including those that record no answer. The rights the seller declared on the listing, which Graunt records: a seller declaration, not a Graunt finding.

rights_training_allowed.description: true keeps only packets whose seller declares that AI models may be trained on them; false keeps only those whose seller declares they may not. The rights the seller declared on the listing, which Graunt records: a seller declaration, not a Graunt finding.

seller_credential.description: Keep only packets whose seller declares a credential: declared keeps listings whose seller declares at least one credential (a trade license, certification, business registration, membership or qualification); checked keeps those whose seller holds at least one that a Graunt operator checked against a registry. A seller declaration that Graunt records, never a Graunt finding, a score or a ranking input.

video_subject.description: Only video listings whose footage shows this subject.

name: search

next_steps.description: Present only when no listing matches.

matched_words.description: The query's words this listing holds, on SOME and WORD_START only (at most 8). how: WORD (the word or a form of it), SYNONYM (as: the phrase from Graunt's synonym table the listing holds), WORD_START (a word in the listing starts with it).

search_match.description: How the listings matched the query. Present whenever a query was given.

title: Search the Graunt catalog
